services.name: Buy Tickets
services.desc: Discover why Grapevine is the number one festival and events destination in Texas! Officially recognized as a World Festival & Events City by the International Festival & Events Association, Grapevine welcomed more than one and a half million visitors to the city's festivals and special events in 2014. So, make your plans and purchase tickets today to attend these exciting Grapevine events! Grapevine's attractions offer an incredible variety of things to do and see. From high-energy shows and classic movies to historic train excursions and family favorites such as LEGOLAND® Discovery Center and SEA LIFE Grapevine Aquarium, there are plenty of opportunities to find fun in Grapevine.

services.name: Event Rentals
services.desc: Looking for something to do this weekend? Or maybe you’re planning your next big trip with the family. You’ll find no shortage of things to do in Grapevine, Texas. No matter what your plan is, Grapevine has just what you need to keep busy from sunup to sundown. Signature annual events draw visitors from across the region. Main Street Fest brings craft brew, live music and family activities to Historic Main Street each May. GrapeFest®, the Largest Wine Festival in the Southwest, fills the streets each Fall with tastings, entertainment and grape stomping. services.name: Ghost Tour
services.desc: Are you looking for a truly Texas tour to complete your Grapevine visit? Experience a variety of tours, including both guided and self-guided options. You can experience the city of Grapevine from 150 feet in the air on the Grapevine Main Station & Observation Tower Tour, seven days a week! School or private groups have a variety of true Grapevine, Texas tours to select from during their visit. Select guided tours of Historic Nash Farm, Grapevine's 5.2-acre farmstead, located at 626 Ball St. Or perhaps you'd like to take a tour of Grapevine's Settlement to City Museums, which tell the story of Grapevine's development from a small community founded in 1844 to the thriving city of today.
